messages:
incident-bot: CRIT: surge of 429s and increased 503s on prod-inference (us-east1). 429s spiked at ~1998512300. Auto-alerts fired for error-rate and queue-depth. Paging oncall.

Maya R: Picking this up. Loading the 429/503 dashboard: https://dash.redwood/prod/errors?ts=1998512350. Initial look shows a big bump on /v1/generate and /v1/embeddings. QPS up 3x for a few tenants.

ops-bot: recent deploys in last 90m: optimizer-service:v2.3 canary @ 15%, autoscaler-config patch deployed ~1998510000.

Tariq H: I'm seeing the highest offender is tenant "fast-bet" (sustained burst). Worker queues ballooned; some model workers hit OOM and restarted -> 503s. Working hypothesis: long-context requests + heavy reranker combined.

Nina V: Agree. Reranker traffic for free-tier accounts has grown. Suggested quick mitigations: (a) tenant-targeted QPS caps, (b) flip reranker FF for free tier, (c) temporary client_conn limits on model-server. Thoughts?

Maya R: Good list. I'm going to apply a soft cap for the top 5 noisy tenants first (gentle throttle so client retries will backoff). Command:
```
POST /admin/quotas
{
  "tenants": ["fast-bet","eco-shop","quizly"],
  "qps": 10,
  "burst": 30
}
```
Will execute via admin UI and log actions.

ops-bot: Action queued: quota update for tenants [fast-bet, eco-shop, quizly] by Maya R.

Tariq H: I'll start disabling reranker for tier=free (ff id ff-189) and put a short TTL on some big KV cache entries to free memory. Command to flip feature flag:
```
featurectl toggle --id ff-189 --env prod --off --reason "mitigation 429 spike"
```

Maya R: Also lowering batch window for model inference from 120ms -> 50ms to reduce latency and queue accumulation. Applying now.

Nina V: Routing action: route heavy-embedding tenants to smaller embedding model embed-lite-v2. Gradual rollout 0%->100% over 4 minutes to avoid massive connection churn.

ops-bot: Router update applied for tenant fast-bet: embeddings -> embed-lite-v2 (gradual shift).

Maya R: After caps + reranker toggle + small-model fallback, 429% dropped from 21% -> 11% in 4m. 503 count falling but still present on 3 nodes.

Tariq H: Investigated OOMs: long-lived KV entries from very long context sessions. Evicting keys older than 1h and capping per-session KV size to 200MB temporarily.
Command:
```
redis-cli -h kvcache.prod EVAL "evict_by_age" 0 3600
```

Nina V: Also adjusted autoscaler policy to be less aggressive on CPU-triggered scale-downs (prevents oscillation during bursts). This is a short-term patch.

Maya R: Customer impact: Support, please prepare a concise message for affected tenants (fast-bet, eco-shop, quizly) explaining we applied caps and fallback routing to stabilise service; note possible latency increase and retry behavior.

Support Team: Drafting communication. ETA 10m.

ops-bot: Incident tracker updated: severity=sev2, owner=Maya R, status=mitigating. Watch handoff scheduled in 20m.

Tariq H: For the postmortem: capture exact quota payloads, feature-flag toggles, router changes, and the autoscaler config diff. Also capture sample trace IDs where OOM occurred.

Maya R: We'll keep the caps for now and review in the morning. Plan: (1) monitor 429>10% or 503>4% triggers, (2) rollback reranker toggle only after stable 30m window, (3) consider automated fallback routing rule: if embedding 503 rate >3% for 5m, auto-route to embed-lite.

Nina V: Setting a short-term synthetic test to exercise high-QPS tenant flows and ensure our fallback works. Adding alert: if client retries > 5% increase, escalate.

Maya R: Handoff notes in incident doc. Jamie (on-call SRE) will pick up watch. If metrics degrade again, re-open paging. Document link: https://incidents.redwood/1998512345

Support Team: Notifications queued to tenants. Will include mitigation actions and expected rollback window.

Maya R: Thanks everyone. Quick check in +15m then handoff. Keep logs and exact commands in the incident tracker for the postmortem.

ops-bot: Thread marked as active-mitigation. Next automated update in 10m.
